See §7A.3.1 for the canonical fix.' — so the canonical no-coercion rule already lives at the `||` row but LPAD/RPAD was NOT cross-referenced. r27 line 3103-3165 — §7A.3.1 'Trino dialect landmine in macro examples — CONCAT and `||` require all-VARCHAR args' is the comprehensive canonical (untouched). r27 line 16 — top-of-file myth-buster #6 already says 'no implicit varchar<->number coercion ...
